== Introduction ==

Andrew Meyer posted this This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time list on The Outer Rim as This Deal Just Got Worse.

== Strategy ==

<blockquote>
Start with Casino, pull security tower and bounty hunter of choice with new SI. Flipping the objective is secondary. Try to use the Fear/Trinto/Sabacc to run them out of cards.
</blockquote>
